ledger.claim: The driver's contact obligation under POL-NS-23 is met in full. The platform chat log records two in-app messages from the driver to the rider (MSG-05069-001 sent 13:27:40 and MSG-05069-003 sent 13:32:00) and a voice-call entry (MSG-05069-002, channel VOICE_CALL_LOG, placed 13:30:15, ringing 24 s, not answered), and all three entries precede trip_record.cancelled_at at 13:33:40. POL-NS-23 is satisfied either way it is read, because it accepts 'a voice-call entry in the chat log' as the call limb.

The rider's counter-statement that 'He never called me, he only sent messages' is contradicted by the platform's own record: the chat log carries an outgoing in-app call entry at 13:30:15, before cancellation. POL-NS-23 treats such an entry as satisfying the call limb, and the chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the rider's account cannot support voiding the fee.

The driver's arrival at the pickup is corroborated under POL-NS-21. The GPS trace's nearest fix to the pickup lies 0.497 m away at 13:27:10, with a reported horizontal accuracy of 6 m, inside the 25 m gps_accuracy_filter_m and well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; derived.arrival reports corroborated = true and accuracy_reported = true. The arrival event at 13:27:15 is therefore established on the trace, not merely asserted.

The free wait was served. This is an on-demand trip with no scheduled_at, so under POL-NS-21 the 300 s free wait ran from the driver's arrival at 13:27:15 and ended at 13:32:15; the driver cancelled at 13:33:40, 385 s after arrival and 85 s after the free wait expired. The driver was entitled to cancel for rider no-show.

POL-NS-24's driver-no-show branch is not engaged. The trip is on-demand and carries no scheduled pickup time, the driver arrived at the pickup at 13:27:15 within about seven minutes of the 13:20:20 booking, and the driver then waited beyond the free wait before cancelling: the 13:20:40 'wait_timer_expired' event at 13:32:20 confirms the rider was not on board when the wait ran out. No FULL_REFUND is due on this clause.

Because the driver cancelled after the free wait, POL-NS-22 applies: the 5.00 SGD no-show fee is charged to the rider and transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel. The fare breakdown confirms fee_charged_sgd 5.00, policy_fee_sgd 5.00, driver_compensation_if_upheld_sgd 5.00 and fee_matches_policy true, so the fee is due to the driver at that figure.

NO_ACTION is not a driver win on this record. The driver is the filer and the ledger already shows payment_status REFUNDED with refund_issued_sgd 5.0 — the 5.00 SGD was refunded to the rider and withheld from the driver at 15:25:40 pending review. Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION outcome leaves that present state standing, which would leave the driver unpaid; the only outcome that moves the money to the driver is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of 5.00 SGD.

Escalation is not warranted under POL-GEN-26. Every fact the no-show rules need — the arrival at the pickup, the message and the call before cancellation, and the 385 s from arrival to cancellation — is carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so no material fact is left unestablished and there is no open question to send to a human reviewer.

The AI may decide this case finally. The amount contested is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD first band, where the AI ruling is final at any confidence, and neither profile carries a fraud flag (rider 0, driver 0), so no 0.95 fraud bar is raised and no human-review referral is triggered.

The one absent artifact does not touch the driver's case. EV-ADVIS-05069-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. A traffic advisory supplies no fact the POL-NS-21/22/23 no-show test uses, so its absence neither opens a question under POL-GEN-26 nor weakens the contact, arrival or free-wait findings, all of which rest on present, COMPLETE artifacts.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this is decided on the platform's own records, which all sit at full weight (1.0). On 17 September 2026 the driver accepted the on-demand trip TRP-05069 at 13:20:40 and reached the pickup at 13:27:15; the driver-device GPS trace confirms the arrival (nearest fix 0.5 m from the pin, 6 m reported accuracy, inside the 25 m accuracy filter and the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, corroborated = true). Because an on-demand trip has no scheduled time, POL-NS-21 runs the 300-second free wait from arrival, so it ran from 13:27:15 and expired at 13:32:15. The driver cancelled at 13:33:40 — 385 seconds after arrival, 85 seconds past the wait — so the driver was entitled to cancel for a rider no-show. Contact under POL-NS-23 is met: before cancelling the driver sent in-app messages at 13:27:40 and 13:32:00 and placed an in-app call at 13:30:15 (ringing 24 s, unanswered). POL-NS-23 requires the call to be placed before cancellation, not answered, and the chat log (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) records it. The rider's account that the driver 'never called me, he only sent messages' therefore cannot void the fee. Because the wait was served and contact was made, POL-NS-22 applies: the 5.00 SGD no-show fee stands and is due to the driver as compensation for time and fuel. The 15:25:40 reversal (rider refunded 5.00 SGD, driver withheld) was provisional pending this review, and this ruling resolves it. POL-NS-22 directs DRIVER_COMPENSATION at the fee charged, 5.00 SGD, and POL-GEN-03 provides that a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling carries the same 5.00 SGD in both amount fields — it is the money the ruling moves, not a second payment. I do not accept the argument that the outcome should be NO_ACTION: NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported, and the driver's claim is supported here. The fee charged was 5.00 SGD, matching the policy fee, so the POL-NS-22 fee-amount referral does not arise, and POL-NS-25 raises no referral because the rider's profile snapshot carries no no_show_cancellations_30d counter. No escalation: every fact these no-show rules need — arrival, the wait, the message and the call before cancellation, and the fee — is carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, and the only impaired artifact, the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-05069-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0), supplies no fact these rules use. The amount contested is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD first band, and neither party carries a fraud flag, so the AI ruling is final. Confidence: the deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 cap is 1.0; I record 0.95.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
